req.title: DELETE is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 for subsequent DELETE calls on the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-028 requires DELETE /tasks/{task_id} to be idempotent: the first call on an existing task returns HTTP 204, and every subsequent call on the same task_id returns HTTP 404. The test suite covers: (1) positive – first DELETE returns 204 with no body; (2) state-transition – second DELETE on the same id returns exactly 404; (3) negative – DELETE on a never-existing id returns 404 immediately; (4) boundary – DELETE on task_id=1 (lowest valid integer) follows the same idempotency contract; (5) decision-table – verifying the 404 detail message content on the second call to catch constant/string mutations. Each test creates its own task via POST so the suite is fully self-contained against an empty database.

tests.name: test_first_delete_returns_204
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ returning HTTP 201
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid title to obtain a task_id
trace: R-TASK-028: first DELETE on existing task must succeed with 2xx
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_first_delete_returns_204():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "task_ep_pos", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()["id"]

    r_del = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_del.status_code == 204
    assert r_del.content == b""

tests.name: test_second_delete_returns_404_idempotency
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ returning HTTP 201
First DELETE on that task_id has already been issued and returned 204
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid title to obtain a task_id
expected: Response JSON detail contains the task_id
trace: R-TASK-028: subsequent DELETE on same task_id must return 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_second_delete_returns_404_idempotency():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "task_stc_idem", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()["id"]

    r1 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r1.status_code == 204

    r2 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    body = r2.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert str(task_id) in body["detail"]

tests.name: test_delete_detail_message_exact_format
preconditions: A task is created and then deleted once
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task and capture task_id
Inspect exact detail string in 404 response
expected: detail equals exactly 'Task with id {task_id} not found'
trace: R-TASK-028: 404 detail string must match the exact constant in delete_task handler

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_detail_message_exact_format():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "task_dt_detail", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()["id"]

    r1 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r1.status_code == 204

    r2 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    body = r2.json()
    expected_detail = f"Task with id {task_id} not found"
    assert body["detail"] == expected_detail

tests.name: test_delete_task_id_1_boundary_idempotency
preconditions: A task is created and its id is captured (lowest auto-assigned id)
actions: POST /tasks/ to create first task (id likely 1 in fresh DB)
GET /tasks/{task_id} to confirm task no longer exists
trace: R-TASK-028: boundary at minimum task_id; GET confirms deletion before second DELETE
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_task_id_1_boundary_idempotency():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "task_bva_min_id", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(task_id, int)

    r1 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    assert r1.content == b""

    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 404

    r2 = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    assert r2.json()["detail"] == f"Task with id {task_id} not found"
